results:
The 1980 neocognitron paper is the Biological Cybernetics article, and a 1979 Japanese-language precursor also exists.

- **The 1980 paper:** Fukushima's English-language article, "Neocognitron: A Self-organizing Neural Network Model for a Mechanism of Pattern Recognition Unaffected by Shift in Position," appeared in Biological Cybernetics 36, pp. 193–202 (doi:10.1007/BF00344251) ([source](https://mlanthology.org/misc/1980/fukushima1980misc-neocognitron)). A full PDF is hosted at [redwood.berkeley.edu](https://redwood.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Fukushima1980.pdf). Its abstract describes a network trained without a teacher that recognizes shapes regardless of position, and its structure resembles the Hubel and Wiesel model of the visual system ([source](https://redwood.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Fukushima1980.pdf)).
- **Earlier version:** Wikipedia dates the neocognitron to 1979, citing a Japanese-language IECE paper from October 1979 ([source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neocognitron)). So "1979" and "1980" both appear in sources, and the discrepancy comes from the Japanese versus English publication.
- **Significance:** Wikipedia's Fukushima biography describes the 1980 paper as the original deep convolutional neural network architecture ([source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kunihiko_Fukushima)). The neocognitron was used for Japanese handwritten character recognition and inspired later convolutional networks ([source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neocognitron)).
- **Architecture:** The network alternates S-type units, which act like convolution kernels, with C-type units, which downsample through spatial averaging. Its kernels are learned through self-organization rather than hand-designed ([source](https://www.asianscientist.com/?p=130665)) ([source](https://taylorandfrancis.com/knowledge/Engineering_and_technology/Artificial_intelligence/Neocognitron)).

content.text:
**答案:福島邦彦(Kunihiko Fukushima)。**

他在 1980 年发表了论文《Neocognitron: A Self-organizing Neural Network Model for a Mechanism of Pattern Recognition Unaffected by Shift in Position》,刊于 Biological Cybernetics 第 36 卷,第 193–202 页。Wikipedia 把新认知机的时间记为 1979 年,依据是同年 10 月发表的一篇日文 IECE 论文。1980 年的英文论文是后来的版本。

Sources:
- [Neocognitron – Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neocognitron)
- [Kunihiko Fukushima – Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kunihiko_Fukushima)
- [Fukushima 1980 论文 PDF(Berkeley Redwood)](https://redwood.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Fukushima1980.pdf)
- [mlanthology 条目](https://mlanthology.org/misc/1980/fukushima1980misc-neocognitron)
